mistake_reason: At step 1, the orchestrator chose FileSurfer to mine local files instead of using WebSurfer to consult authoritative, up-to-date online sources (e.g., the official Malko site or Wikipedia). This inappropriate tool selection (FM-4.3) led the team to rely on an outdated local defunct-states CSV that misclassified pre-1999 Venezuela as a defunct country and on a PDF/spreadsheet that collapsed East/West Germany into modern Germany. By not using the proper web tool, the agents missed the accurate record that 1983 winner Claus Peter Flor’s nationality was East Germany and incorrectly concluded the answer was Jan.
